learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the magic grammar spells to change a single object into many objects using singular and plural rules!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Singular means only ONE of something, like 'one cat'. Plural means MORE THAN ONE, like 'two cats' or 'many boxes'!
Most words become plural just by adding an 's' at the end (book -> books). But if a word ends in s, sh, ch, or x, we add 'es' to make it plural (box -> boxes).
If a word ends in a consonant + 'y', we drop the 'y' and add 'ies' (baby -> babies). If it ends in 'f' or 'fe', we usually change it to 'ves' (leaf -> leaves)!
Some words are rebels and change their spelling completely! 'Child' becomes 'children', 'tooth' becomes 'teeth', and 'mouse' becomes 'mice'.

fun_activity.title: 🛒 The Plural Grocery List
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are throwing a party! Write a grocery list but change these singular words to plural: 1 tomato, 1 cherry, 1 loaf of bread, and 1 candy.

quick_recap: ⭐ Singular means one, and Plural means more than one.
⭐ We add 's' or 'es' to most regular nouns to make them plural.
⭐ Some nouns change completely (man -> men), and some stay exactly the same (sheep -> sheep)!
